description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's rev-list formatting and encoding features. It contains test setup, execution, and validation logic for various format specifiers, color outputs, encoding conversions, and other Git revisions list operations.

methods.name: test_format
methods.description: Performs a format comparison test for git rev-list outputs given a format string.

methods.name: test_pretty
methods.description: Performs a pretty format test for git rev-list outputs with specified format names.

methods.name: has_color
methods.description: Checks if the output contains expected color escape sequences.

methods.name: has_no_color
methods.description: Checks if the output does not contain color escape sequences.
